MODELS
ACTIV
ACTIV is the nimble compact car for those who like to live life on the
adventurous side.
Standard equipment includes unique front and rear bumpers, rocker
panel trim, roof rails, fender flares, 15-inch Gunmetal Silver-painted
aluminum wheels and front foglamps with chrome rings.
Jet Black leatherette heated front seats and a leather-wrapped
steering wheel add the finishing touches. The rest is up to you.
2LT
A Spark with plenty of style as well as available safety features to
help alert you to potential dangers.
A Driver Confidence Package1 including Forward Collision Alert, Lane
Departure Warning and Automatic Emergency Braking is available.
You’ll also find Keyless Open and Start and Rear Park Assist1 that can
help guide you while parking in tight spots.
1 Read the vehicle Owner’s Manual for important feature limitations and information.
